tables.name: Current Issue
tables.description: What might be causing problems for the fortress at the moment. Each issue (not Peaceful) rolls its severity.

results.name: Peaceful
results.description: Everything seems alright at the moment.

results.name: Entryway Malfunction
results.description: A door, gate, portcullis, or drawbridge is experiencing an issue.

results.name: Hurt on the Job
results.description: A guard, or staff member, has been recently injured while performing their duties.

results.name: Poachers
results.description: Evidence of poaching was discovered on the lands surrounding the fortress.

results.name: Family Illness
results.description: A member of the ranking resident’s immediate family has gotten sick. If they are not in residence, then a close friend or associate.

results.name: Worker Illness
results.description: A member of the household staff or guard has gotten sick.

results.name: Spoiled Food
results.description: Some (or all) of the fresh food items have gone bad.

results.name: Stolen Goods
results.description: Some of the food and/or supplies have been swiped.

results.name: Structural Damage [Weather]
results.description: An area of the fortress has been damaged by the elements.

results.name: Structural Damage [Neglect]
results.description: An area of the fortress has been overlooked for too long, and has now collapsed.

results.name: Structural Damage [Someone’s Mistake]
results.description: An area of the fortress has been compromised and someone is at fault (perhaps a repair, or element of construction, was attempted with unsuitable tools or materials).

results.name: Infestation
results.description: Pests have encroached on the fortress and become a nuisance.

results.name: Magical Anomaly
results.description: An area of magical disturbance is causing problems. Residents may, or may not, be aware of what caused the anomaly.

results.name: Creature
results.description: A strange beast, or monster, has been roaming inside, or near to, the fortress’ boundary.

results.name: Unwanted Attention
results.description: Unfriendly outsiders have recently become interested in the fortress (or those inside it).
